title: Vaudreuil to Berryer, Montréal, 29 Aug 1760 (ANOM COL F3 16 ff.115r-v, the first two pages of ff.115-119): the cipher letter announcing the loss of Canada, with its period decipherment, and the 1757 table checked on it

documents.shelfmark: ANOM COL F3 16 (Moreau de Saint-Méry), ff.115r-v (IREL images FRANOM82_247MIOM013_F3_016_187-188, microfilm 247 MIOM 13); the letter continues on ff.116-119 (images 189-195), not in this entry

plaintext.source: Period decipherment above every line (gloss_ff115.txt); Parkman, Montcalm and Wolfe II (1884) pp.380-381 translates passages of the letter (English); Richard 1899 calendar summarises it (lead 1208).

transcription.notes: ff.115r-v only (561 groups and the gloss). ff.116-119 are not transcribed and are outside this entry.

system.summary: 700-entry table of numbered words, place and ship names, syllables and single letters (1757 Vaudreuil table), with names and titles left in clear and phonetic spelling.
system.sibling_key: The same 1757 table reads cat. 1388 (8 Apr 1759), 1389 (10 Apr 1759) and 1390 (16 Apr 1759) of C11A 104 in full; cat. 1392 (Trémais) uses another code. Sheet e001295272 of the same volume does not fit.
system.notes: Table in numerical order only on the sheet used (the alphabetical sheets e001295267/69 give the same entries by word).

prior_solution.where: Interlinear period decipherment on the original; partial English translation in Parkman 1884.

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout downloaded the ANOM images (IREL, 23 Nov 2026) and set the rules (protocol hashed before any computation, key frozen by its upstream SHA-256, one measurement); AI agents transcribed, measured and wrote up. No person has checked the transcription.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: ff.115r-v: 561 groups and the interlinear gloss transcribed apart.

Frozen 1757 Vaudreuil table (targets/vaudreuil1759a/dudout/key.tsv, the key of targets/vaudreuil1759a-c; same values as our local KEY_v2.tsv, SHA-256 7b5aecb2..., which differs only by its English header) on ff.115r-v vs the gloss: 0.9739 characters vs best of 200 shuffled tables 0.2221 (mean 0.142); criterion >= 0.85 and >= best + 0.30.

outcome.method_basis: The period decipherment gives the text; the 1757 table (C11E 10, LAC e001295274) is shown to be still in use on 29 Aug 1760.
outcome.fraction_read_source: gloss_ff115.txt: 318/318 gloss words of ff.115r-v legible; 294/318 (92.5%) also supported letter for letter by the table. ff.116-119 not counted.

credits.note: interlinear period decipherment on F3 16 ff.115r-v (it continues on ff.116-119)
ff.115r-v transcribed from the ANOM images; the 1757 table validated on them
